blocks.text: CITY OF SAN FERNANDO—A bomb threat at the Our Lady of Fatima University campus in Pampanga prompted school and police officials to suspend classes on Thursday morning. The bomb threat was conveyed in a note left in one of the comfort rooms, according to Col. Ricardo David, Pampanga police director. David said the note was not signed. READ: Bomb threat prompts FEU Manila to suspend classes Around 4,000 students exited the campus in an orderly fashion between 8 a.m. and 9 am.
